title: FuelTech Boost Controller & Dashboard
tag_line: FuelTech-inspired boost controller and telemetry dashboard. Auto-installs on every vehicle — no Vehicle Config step.
message:
FuelTech Boost Controller & Dashboard

A FuelTech-inspired boost-by-RPM controller + dashboard widget.

Auto-installs on every car — no setup, no part to enable. Just drop the zip in mods/.

WHAT IT DOES
- Boost-by-RPM map — 6 drag-to-tune breakpoints. Whatever PSI you set, the controller delivers.
- Presets — OFF / STOCK / MAX / AUTO MAX (max safe boost without engine damage) / CUSTOM
- Anti-Lag (ALS) — keeps the turbo spooled off-throttle
- Custom TCS — optional traction control for cars without native TC
- Auto-save — your custom maps persist across Ctrl+R, part swaps, and reloads
- Safety cut — boost drops to zero on coolant / oil overheat

DASHBOARD WIDGET
- Resizable widget — place it anywhere, size it how you like
- Mini boost-map preview with live RPM cursor — always visible
- Full draggable TUNE panel with boost map + projected power/torque curves
- Oil temp, water temp, G-force, 0-100/0-200 drag timer, brake temps, damage log
- Telemetry strip: weight, load, fuel, clutch, altitude, odometer
- Defers to BeamNG's stock RPM, speedo, and gear gauges — no duplicate clutter

INSTALL (2 steps)
1. Download the .zip — do NOT extract it
2. Drop it in Documents\BeamNG.drive\mods\ and restart BeamNG
3. Add "FuelTech Dashboard" from UI Apps

Still not working?
- Dashboard not in UI Apps? The zip is in the wrong folder — also try %LocalAppData%\BeamNG.drive\<version>\mods\
- ACTIVE never lights up on a turbo car? Restart BeamNG fully (close to desktop, reopen).

COMPATIBILITY
- BeamNG.drive 0.34+ (tested on 0.39)
- Turbo, supercharged, and NA vehicles
- Touch support (Steam Deck / touchscreen)
